systems.tiers: Instituted by Article 142-11 of the bill; a civil-status centre (the commune seat is the principal centre) that is computerised and connected to it may keep its registers in a single copy; operation left to a decree

note: Bill text of the Persons and Family Code (August 2025, excerpt ending at Title IV chapter IV): a law, which places nothing. It provides for communal civil-status centres being 'informatisé et connecté' to the national digital register but states no office as connected.
